summary: Minimal, symmetric fix: adds _legacy_encode() and routes encode() through it when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM='sha1', mirroring existing _legacy_decode() fallback already used for decode(). Directly implements the fix proposed in the issue with no scope creep or regression risk to the default (non-sha1) path.

issues.description: Local variable `hash` shadows builtin, matching existing style in _legacy_decode but not ideal practice.
